implementation_prompt.title: Sarvam parse fix, Gemini 3.8 Flash adjudicator, accuracy eval on one real policy PDF
implementation_prompt.persona: Act as a pragmatic MVP implementation owner. Fix only what the smoke test proved broken. Short PLAN, BUILD, FEEDBACK loops. Evidence before claims. Terse reports. Do not propose feature enhancements. Report fixes only.
implementation_prompt.mvp_stance: MVP: accuracy and code quality need to be honest, not production grade. Still obey AGENTS.md invariants (consent gate, model output is only extracted_unverified | conflicting | unknown, no PII in repo or logs).

smoke_test_findings.finding: Gemini model id in .env is gemini-2.5-flash-exp and returns HTTP 404. Key is valid. gemini-3.8-flash is listed for this key and returned HTTP 200 on generateContent. Fix: LLM_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash in .env and .env.example. Grep scripts/smoke-test-gemini.mjs for the stale default.

Live Sarvam digitise job succeeds (synthetic 1 page, real PDF 20 pages as 2 segments of 10, usage pages_failed=0). src/integrations/sarvam/doc-ai-transport.js normalizeResult (around line 225-232) throws OCR_PROVIDER_PAGE_MISMATCH "Sarvam page mapping is invalid." because live pages carry page_num and blocks[] (block_id, text, layout_tag, reading_order, coordinates, bbox_norm), not page_number and content:string. Mocked tests encode the wrong shape. This blocks all live OCR. Fix: accept page_num, build page text from blocks sorted by reading_order, keep layout_tag, keep fail-closed on missing, duplicate or reordered pages. Correct the mocked fixtures to the live shape.

Sarvam real-PDF parse structure is healthy: 20 pages, 0 empty blocks, tags header, headline, image, section-title, paragraph, footer, page-number, table (24), footnote, image-caption. Text correctness is not yet scored. That is this plan's eval.
No prior eval measures parse accuracy against ground truth. Docs state accuracy corpus is unverified.

target.t1: Live Sarvam output normalizes to knowvia.ocr.v1 for the real 20 page PDF with zero page loss.
target.t2: Field extraction score on the real PDF against a human verified golden file, per field and overall.
target.t3: Gemini 3.8 Flash adjudicates only disagreements, returns a verdict with evidence, and its verdict is stored as extracted_unverified or conflicting, never as final truth.
target.t4: Snapshot report: accuracy score, what works, what fails, fix list.

scope.in: F1 and F2 fixes. Golden file. Eval harness. Adjudicator addon. Live opt-in tests. Report.
scope.out: New features, UI, PostgreSQL, deployment, multi-document corpus, production scale claims, prompt tuning beyond making the eval run, Sarvam cancellation or deletion work.
scope.owned_paths: src/integrations/sarvam/doc-ai-transport.js src/modules/ai-analysis/ (adjudicator file only) tests/sarvam-doc-ai.test.mjs (fixture shape fix) tests/evals/parse-accuracy.test.mjs (new, opt-in) scripts/eval-parse.mjs (new) .env.example, scripts/smoke-test-gemini.mjs (model id only)

implementation_prompt.data_handling: The PDF is a real policy schedule with personal data. It stays at its Downloads path. Raw Sarvam output, golden file, run reports with values: write only under .local/eval/ (gitignored). Committed files hold structure, field names, scores and redacted examples only. No names, addresses, policy numbers or IDs in code, tests, logs, prompts or commits. Do not commit or push. Provider calls run only through the existing consent gate with a document-specific grant for sarvam and gemini. Never print API keys.

build_plan.step: Set LLM_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash. Re-run curl style smoke. Expect HTTP 200.
Failing test first: fixture in live shape (page_num, blocks). Then patch normalizeResult. Run npm test (sarvam-doc-ai, ocr-pipeline) and npm run test:sarvam-live. Expect live test green.

Draft candidate fields from Sarvam text (insurer, plan name, policy number, insured members, dates, sum insured, premium, room rent, co-payment, waiting periods, add-ons, exclusions list presence). Owner confirms every value against the PDF by eye. Save as .local/eval/golden.json with page number per field. Unconfirmed fields are excluded from the score.

Run the existing extraction path on Sarvam text. Each field gets a value or unknown plus source page. Compare to golden using normalized comparison (case, whitespace, currency, date format). Classify each field: match, mismatch, missing, hallucinated.

Trigger only when: extractor value is mismatch vs a second signal (Sarvam block text regex or table cell), or extractor returned conflicting, or confidence below threshold, or field missing but the golden page hint says present. Never for fields that agree. Send one batched request with only the disputed field names and the minimal quoted Sarvam block snippets (not the full document). Model gemini-3.8-flash, temperature 0, JSON schema output {field, verdict: a|b|neither|unknown, value, evidence_quote, page}. Reject output whose evidence_quote is not a substring of the supplied snippets. Persist as extracted_unverified or conflicting. Cap calls per document and log token usage.
Score before adjudication and after. Write .local/eval/report.json and a redacted markdown snapshot.
Read-only review of consent, model-authority and data-handling per AGENTS.md. Then npm run check, npm run eval:safety, git diff --check.

metrics.m: Pages returned / pages in PDF. Pass: 20 of 20.
Matched golden fields / confirmed golden fields. Pass: at least 0.85 overall.
Policy number, insured names, sum insured, premium, policy period, room rent limit, co-payment. Pass: 1.00 exact. Any critical miss is a fail.
Fields with a value not present in source text / total fields. Pass: 0.
Accuracy after minus before. Pass: not negative.
Adjudicator corrections that are right per golden / corrections made. Pass: at least 0.80.
Gemini calls per document. Pass: at most 2, and zero when no disagreement exists.

evaluation.verdict_rule: PASS: page_recall, critical_field_accuracy, hallucination_rate and adjudicator_lift all pass, and F1, F2 closed with tests that fail on old code. PARTIAL: critical pass, overall below 0.85. FAIL: any critical miss or page loss.
evaluation.method_validity: Method is right only if the golden file was human verified, the scorer is deterministic, the adjudicator cannot see the golden file, and a negative control (field removed from the snippet) makes the adjudicator return unknown. Mocked tests do not count as journey proof. State what stays unverified.

implementation_prompt.execution: Run in a separate session and agent from the planning session. One worktree. Follow steps in order. Consult Opus 5.5 at medium effort only when a scoring or authority question is genuinely ambiguous. Final report: changes, evidence, checks, unverified items, security and data impact, rollback, follow-ups. Rollback: revert the two source edits and the .env model id. No data migration involved.
